Data: yuval-harpaz/alarms (Pikud HaOref via Tzofar). Terrain: SRTM30+, about 1 km. Borders: Natural Earth, smoothed. Arc colour shifts from pink to orange with range; drones are violet. Long-range arcs enter from the map edge in the direction of origin. On the heaviest days, nearby alerts are merged into thicker arcs. Zoom in to see place names. "Other" (unattributed alerts, drawn without an arc) is off by default. Space plays or pauses; arrow keys step a day.
